size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the reset-password controller, which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/reset-password?token= and its 401.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/reset-password?token=<token from the reset email> with a valid new password always returns 401 'Password reset failed', even for a token that was just issued.

root_cause.detail: resetPassword reads the token from req.body.token instead of req.query.token; the token is undefined, jwt.verify throws and the service returns 401.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/reset-password > should return 204 and reset the password
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 204 and reset the password'
